column1: # sdk/android-parity.tsv -- the android.* surface picodroid.* mirrors, one row per
# class (or per member, when a class is tracked member by member).
# Columns: android <TAB> picodroid <TAB> status <TAB> note   (the note is optional)
#   android    the Android (or androidx / Material / java) class, dotted; a member
#   picodroid  the SDK source under sdk/java/ that serves it (`picodroid/view/View`),
#   status     live          the API surface and semantics port unchanged
#              partial       present; a subset, or a documented behaviour difference
#              missing       absent, and in scope: an entry for docs/gaps.md
#              out-of-scope  absent on purpose (hardware, a decision); not counted
#              addition      a picodroid class with no Android counterpart; not counted
#   note       why, briefly; the compatibility matrix carries the detail
# scripts/scorecard.py reads this file: it fails when a live or partial row names
# a source file that does not exist, and when a missing row names one that does;
# it lists SDK classes that have no row here. Parity per package is
# (live + partial / 2) / (live + partial + missing). The floor below only goes up;
# raise it in the commit that earns the rise.
